# action.docker_image_prune

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Removes unused images, like `docker image prune`, and reports the space reclaimed. By default only dangling (untagged) images go; with `dangling = false` every image no container uses is removed (`docker image prune -a`).

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_image_prune.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_image_prune" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_image_prune.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_image_prune.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dangling` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Remove only dangling images. Default `true`; `false` removes all unused images. |
| `filters` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Prune filters, one value per key: `until` (e.g. `24h` or a timestamp; not applied to volumes), `label` (`key` or `key=value`) and `label!` (the negation). |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_image" "app" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_image_prune.dangling]
    }
  }
}

# Removes the dangling image left behind when the tag moves. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_image_prune.dangling
action "docker_image_prune" "dangling" {
  config {
    dangling = true
    filters  = { "label!" = "keep" }
  }
}
```
